scenario:
Seven documentary films — Fracture, Glacier, Hollow, Indelible, Junction, Kindred, and Lapses — will be screened one at a time on seven consecutive evenings, Monday through Sunday, with exactly one film screened each evening. The following conditions govern the schedule:
1. Fracture is screened earlier in the week than Glacier.
2. Hollow is not screened on Monday or Sunday.
3. Indelible is screened immediately before or immediately after Junction.
4. Kindred is not screened immediately before or immediately after Fracture.
5. If Glacier is screened on Thursday, then Lapses is screened on Monday.
6. Indelible is screened earlier in the week than Fracture.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following must be true?

explanations.correct: Junction must be screened before Saturday (day 6). Rule 3 requires Indelible and Junction to be adjacent. Rule 7 requires Indelible before Fracture, and rule 1 requires Fracture before Glacier. So the chain Indelible → Fracture → Glacier occupies at least 3 days. Since Indelible and Junction are adjacent, Junction is either one position before or one after Indelible. In every valid arrangement, Glacier must fall no later than day 7, Fracture at most day 6, and Indelible at most day 5. If Junction were on day 6 or 7, Indelible would have to be on day 5 or 6 respectively (to be adjacent), but then Fracture ≥ 6 and Glacier ≥ 7 — only barely fitting. Checking: if Junction = 7, Indelible = 6, Fracture ≥ 7, impossible since Glacier must come after Fracture. If Junction = 6, Indelible = 5, Fracture ≥ 6 but day 6 is taken by Junction, so Fracture = 7, then Glacier must be after day 7 — impossible. Therefore Junction ≤ 5, i.e., Junction is screened no later than Friday, which means Junction is screened before Saturday. This is always true.
